items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Walter Winchell wrote a beautiful article and so did Dorothy Kilgallen, about me working in those thin dresses

ctx.x: Even in that cold weather. So they told me in later years I was going to feel it. Walter Winchell wrote a beautiful article and so did Dorothy Kilgallen, about me working in those thin dresses, and no coat or anything around me. And the men with their gloves and things on. And I didn't even catch cold. Never caught cold. But now I am. I'm suffering from it, you see, now. And then, after having gone through ETO and the South Pacific, then I did Stateside. I played all around here, all around the states, you know,…
